Class SshServer

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.SshServer
@Component public class SshServer extends Object
The SshServer class is the Casserole SSH listener. Apache MINA SSHD is the library that accepts the password, binds the port, and loads the host key from the casserole settings. Each connection asks ChatShellFactory for a shell. The listen loop runs on the SSH input-output lane. The bean does not start itself. InitRunner calls start(). Lamina receives the listen task from that call. A stop lets the failed accept land before the group executor closes. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshServer

    • LOG

      private static final org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger LOG

    • ACCEPT_SETTLE_MS

      private static final long ACCEPT_SETTLE_MS
      The value is how long to wait so a failed accept can land after the acceptor closes. Windows IOCP delivers that failure after the close. Zulu 26 runs that delivery on an InnocuousThread. The group must still be open, or NoCloseExecutor throws and the drain returns at once. The wait is 1000 milliseconds.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • GROUP_GRACE_MS

      private static final long GROUP_GRACE_MS
      The value is how long the group stays open so in-flight NIO work can finish. The NIO2 factory waits this long inside awaitTermination. On this JDK that call returns immediately. The drain stays here while the executor still accepts the accept callback. The wait is 5000 milliseconds.
      See Also:

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      The method submits the MINA listen loop onto the SSH input-output lane. A listen task that is already running returns without a second submit.

    • listenLoop

      private void listenLoop()
      The method binds the listener, accepts passwords, and waits until shutdown() clears the running flag. The port, the idle timeout, and the host-key path come from the casserole SSH settings. A failed password is reported to SshIoTrace. The shell factory is ChatShellFactory. After start, the method logs a banner and prints that same banner. The loop then waits one second at a time. An interrupt clears the running flag. Any other failure is logged and printed.

    • applyIdleTimeout

      private void applyIdleTimeout(org.apache.sshd.server.SshServer server, long idleTimeoutMs)
      The method replaces the listener idle timeout. The built-in idle timeout is 600 seconds unless this method stores another duration. A value of 0 or less stores a zero duration, which means the timeout is not a positive wait. A positive value stores that many milliseconds. // @aa-sdd G-23 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md
      Parameters:
      server - The server is the listener being configured.
      idleTimeoutMs - The timeout is the idle wait in milliseconds. 0 means never time out.

    • shutdown

      @PreDestroy public void shutdown()
      The method stops MINA and then releases the listen task. The group waits inside sshd.stop(). The listen task stays until that wait returns. A stop failure is logged. The method logs when the stop begins and when it ends.

    • settleAccept

      private static void settleAccept()
      The method waits so the Windows accept failure can land before the group executor closes. The wait is ACCEPT_SETTLE_MS.

    • drainGroup

      private static void drainGroup()
      The method holds the group open so in-flight NIO work can finish. The wait is GROUP_GRACE_MS.

    • pause

      private static void pause(long millis)
      The method sleeps for the given number of milliseconds. An interrupt sets the interrupt flag again and returns.
      Parameters:
      millis - The count is how long to hold the executor open.
